def fitmodel(phasefn):
    def res(p):
        w,k1,k2=p[0],p[1],p[2]
        f=np.cos(w*t+phasefn(k1,k2))
        g=np.sin(w*t+phasefn(k1,k2))
        B=np.column_stack([P,f,g,f*x,g*x])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,y,rcond=None)
        return y-B@c
    best=None
    for w0 in [0.3,0.34,0.4]:
        for k0 in [0.0,0.6,-0.6,1.2]:
            r=least_squares(res,[w0,k0,0.0])
            e=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(y)
            if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,r.x)
    return best
